title: juncus lampocarpus var. littoralis
intro: Juncus lampocarpus var. littoralis, commonly known as Marsh Cotton-Grass, is a type of aquatic plant species found in wetlands and coastal areas. This plant has been reported to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help in treating conditions such as wounds and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Juncus lampocarpus var. littoralis include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
